card.name: Old currency amounts before the unit
card.fires_on: Numbers, commas and linking words just before an old-style currency unit such as shillings, guilders, pounds or florins. It is found in historical text about coins and fines.

modes.label: Digits of a price
modes.description: Digits of a sum of money in a historical fine or licence fee, right before the currency name.
modes.example: was subject to a fine of <<2>>5 guilders - a fairly hefty sum

modes.label: Linking words in currency lists
modes.description: A comma, 'of' or 'the' within a list or phrase naming pounds, shillings and pence.
modes.example: abbreviated as £sd after the symbols for pounds<<,>> shillings and pence

card.writes: It seems to suppress the next word being a transport word, and the promoted tokens are all about transport.
card.plain: It lights up when old money amounts like shillings or guilders are about to be named.
